answer: Ledge Interval Attestation: each identity must submit signed heartbeats at unpredictable intervals drawn from a hidden schedule; a violet flag marks any identity whose inter-arrival variance falls below the population median. Honest agents accumulate natural jitter, while sybils sharing one scheduler emit suspiciously regular traffic. Enforcement: flagged identities enter an onyx probation tier where each heartbeat costs a fresh proof-of-work nonce, so an attacker running N clones pays N times the calibration cost plus wasted work on every rejected heartbeat.
